The topology mask shows a single coherent blob, but visually, the individual rods and pivots are indistinguishable and melted together. This is a classic AI failure mode for complex mechanical assemblies.
3. Perspective Distortion (Severity 2.0): I agree. The wheel rims have inconsistent elliptical projections, suggesting a slight warping of the 3D structure.
